Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Picking up my little brother from the gym last week, I saw a really fat guy and a regular-sized one waiting outside. The regular-sized guy had told me that he never does any kind of physical activity, he just comes to give his fat friend rides, since he's always playing sports and stuff. Who is too lazy to play sports?
A. The fat guy
B. The regular-sized guy
C. Cannot be determined
